name: prefix-cache

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec none --prefix-cache on --no-vision --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: families::inkling2_loop:: (host: backend cache bookkeeping on a recording rank, the real Engine over a simulated rank with the Mini's state structure, the plan and the by-name refusals)

prefix_exact_at_cuts (20 cuts: below, at and above the 1,024 window, around the ring wraps at 1,031 and 2,062, page boundaries, different chunk grids; state, last row, logits plane of the first decode step, decode)
prefix_logits_planes_equal (hidden, core_out, h_final, logits of the next chunk byte-equal at 4 cuts)
prefix_restore_after_eviction (donor slot reused, snapshot evicted, 3 restores, non-vacuity negative, no leak)
prefix_restore_beside_decoding_streams (restore and prefill between the windows of two streams, three streams in one window)
cache: 5 prompts (29 to 73,167 tokens) uncached/cold/warm and 2 shared-prefix pairs (2,081 and 73,246 tokens), PREFIX_CACHE=on
evict (24 prompts over 16 snapshot slots, reverse re-ask: 16 restores, 8 misses) and concurrent (3 restores and 1 cold at once, each equal to its solo run)

commands: REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 cargo test -p gb-model --lib --locked families::inkling2_loop::   (also families::inkling2::, family::, plan::, serve::), run in the engine worktree

NODE=node-3 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree> PKG=gb-model TEST_ENV='REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_DIR=/home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw' scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_loop_prefix prefix_exact_at_cuts
the same with the filters: prefix_logits_planes_equal prefix_restore_after_eviction prefix_restore_beside_decoding_streams prefix_long_prompt prefix_snapshot_costs
./inkling2mini.sh build de2d4a30e423a6e671b797cc6c0b9c1848703c27   (.env: NODES=node-3 REXL3_SRC=<engine worktree> SPEC=none VISION=off PREFIX_CACHE=on)

./inkling2mini.sh memwatch begin; ./inkling2mini.sh start; ./inkling2mini.sh bench cache; python3 bench/tools/cache_stress.py --url http://node-3:8000 --model inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --out cache-stress.json
notes: Engine commit de2d4a3 is what the node built and ran; the branch tip 103f373 adds only a rustfmt re-wrap of three new files (snapshot.rs, backend_cache_tests.rs, inkling2_loop_prefix.rs). The first two GPU runs (prefix_exact_at_cuts, and the planes/eviction/concurrent/long/costs run) used the working tree of commits 5f2d5f2 + the test file; prefix_restore_after_eviction was re-run after the non-vacuity negative was added (raw/gpu-prefix_restore_after_eviction-rerun.log). The cache gate and stress ran on the live server with the cache on, SPEC=none, VISION=off. Images and a drafter with the cache are not built (refused by name). The gb-server test inkling2_loop_bare_model_flag_applies_int8_kv_four_lanes_no_drafts_and_aliases fails on this branch and on its base (it asserts the tower is not built); it is not part of this record.
